question: Which musical tālas are assigned to the six-faced deity and to Jyeṣṭhā?
premises: The six-faced deity has the udghaṭa tāla.
inference: The udghaṭa tāla belongs to the six-faced deity, and the kuñcita-tāla belongs to Jyeṣṭhā.
plain_english: The six-faced deity should have the udghaṭa tāla, and Jyeṣṭhā should have the kuñcita-tāla.
